text: Hi darling, I finally got a signal out here on the rig. I have been thinking about you all day and I wanted to hear your voice before my shift starts.
tell: Remote job with unreliable contact is the standard cover for never meeting or video calling.

text: Hello, sorry, I think I dialled the wrong number, but you sound so kind. I am new in this city and don't know anyone yet, would you mind talking for a minute?
tell: The 'wrong number' opener is used to start long-con romance and investment relationships.

text: My love, I have wonderful news. The contract payment finally came through, and once I clear one small problem I can book my flight to come and see you.
tell: A long-awaited meeting that depends on 'one small problem' foreshadows the first request for money.

text: I am a surgeon with the United Nations medical team, stationed abroad for another six months. We are not allowed to make video calls from the base for security reasons.
tell: Prestigious overseas posting plus a rule against video calls explains away why you have never seen them live.

text: My financial advisor showed me how I tripled my savings on this crypto trading platform. I can send you my account screenshots, all the returns are verified.
tell: Screenshots of guaranteed-looking returns from an online friend are the hook of investment 'pig butchering' fraud.

text: The box contains my late father's gold and the inheritance documents. The diplomatic courier company is licensed, and the customs lawyer has confirmed everything is legal.
tell: Inheritance shipments via 'diplomatic couriers' always end in release fees paid by the victim.

text: Please don't tell your children about us yet. They won't understand what we have, and they will try to turn you against me before we even get to meet.
tell: Pre-emptively discrediting family is how romance scammers cut off the people who would spot the fraud.

text: Your bank manager doesn't understand international transfers, they will just block it and ask silly questions. If they ask, tell them the money is for a family member.
tell: Coaching you to lie to the bank neutralises the fraud checks designed to protect you.

text: Let's move our chats to this private messaging app. The dating site reads everything and it keeps deleting the messages I send to you.
tell: Leaving the platform escapes its fraud detection and account bans.

text: They are holding my passport at the airport until I pay a release fee, and if I miss this flight I lose my contract. You are the only person I can turn to right now.
tell: Sudden crisis that only your money can solve, framed so refusing feels like abandoning them.

text: The trading window closes tonight, and the platform only allows withdrawals after the minimum deposit is completed. If we wait, your profits will be frozen.
tell: Paying to withdraw 'profits' is the defining sign of a fake investment platform.

text: The hospital won't start my treatment until the deposit is paid, and my bank card is blocked overseas. Please, my love, I am really scared.
tell: Medical emergency with conveniently blocked cards; no legitimate hospital requires a partner abroad to pay.

text: Could you send three thousand dollars through a money transfer service in my agent's name? I will pay you back the moment I land, I promise on my life.
tell: Money to a third-party 'agent' by wire transfer is unrecoverable and never repaid.

text: Transfer the tax clearance fee to the platform's wallet address I sent you, and then your full balance can be withdrawn to your bank.
tell: Every fee paid unlocks another fee; the balance does not exist.

text: Just buy the gift cards at the pharmacy, scratch off the codes and send me the pictures. That is the only payment they accept over here.
tell: No hospital, airport or government accepts gift card codes as payment.
